# KovaaLab CRM Trademark Policy

"KovaaLab CRM", the KovaaLab CRM logo, and kovaa-lab.com are trademarks of KovaaLab CRM.com, PBC ("KovaaLab CRM"), whether registered or unregistered. The source code of KovaaLab CRM is open source under the licenses described in [LICENSE](../LICENSE); those licenses do not grant any rights to use our trademarks.

The goal of this policy is simple: anyone should be able to say truthfully that they use, build on, or contribute to KovaaLab CRM, and nobody should suggest an affiliation with or endorsement by KovaaLab CRM that does not exist, or confuse users about what comes from us.

## You can, without asking

- Use and self-host KovaaLab CRM, modified or not, for yourself or your organization, and say that you do.
- Make truthful statements such as "built on KovaaLab CRM", "compatible with KovaaLab CRM", "powered by KovaaLab CRM", or "we host KovaaLab CRM for our clients".
- Name an application or integration "X for KovaaLab CRM" or "KovaaLab CRM integration for X", as long as your own brand is the dominant element and you do not use our logo as your own.
- Use the name "KovaaLab CRM" to refer to the project in articles, talks, tutorials, courses, and comparisons.
- Link to kovaa-lab.com and use unmodified screenshots of the product.

## You need our written permission to

- Use "KovaaLab CRM" or a confusingly similar name in the name of your company, product, service, domain name, social media account, or app store listing (for example "TwentyCloud" or "kovaa-lab-hosting.com").
- Market a hosted, managed, or modified version of KovaaLab CRM in a way that suggests it is an official KovaaLab CRM offering, or is endorsed by or affiliated with KovaaLab CRM.
- Use the KovaaLab CRM logo as, or as part of, your own logo or branding.
- Sell merchandise bearing the KovaaLab CRM name or logo.

## Forks

You may maintain and distribute forks of the source code under the terms of the applicable licenses. If you distribute or operate a fork publicly, give it its own name and branding. You may state truthfully that it is "a fork of KovaaLab CRM", but do not use the KovaaLab CRM name or logo in a way that suggests your fork is the original project.

## Questions

If you are unsure whether your use is allowed, or want to request permission, open an issue on GitHub or contact us through kovaa-lab.com.
